result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks and sidewalks, but is characterized by wide asphalt expanses and long crossing distances. The environment is heavily dominated by utility infrastructure and lacks traffic calming measures like curb extensions or street trees.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide intersection with no refuge, increasing exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Visual Clutter
hazards.description: Numerous utility poles and signs may distract drivers or partially obscure pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install clear pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide better information to crossing pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a buffer between the sidewalk and roadway and naturally calm traffic speeds.

result.summary: The intersection provides essential pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and tactile curb ramps. However, the large crossing distances across multiple lanes and the lack of physical buffers or greenery create a high-exposure environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing their time of exposure to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway crossing to the right

hazards.name: Visual Clutter
hazards.description: Numerous utility poles and overhead wires may distract drivers or partially obscure traffic signals.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add trees or planters to the large paved corner area to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk further into the roadway to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features marked crosswalks and curb ramps but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and physical buffers from traffic. The environment is dominated by wide asphalt surfaces and commercial land use, which typically encourages higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular traffic lights which may not provide adequate clearance time.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry on the left appears wide, which facilitates high-speed right turns by vehicles across the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles by tightening the corner radius.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the environment is dominated by a wide, multi-lane roadway with heavy vehicle traffic and significant visual obstructions from large trucks, lacking a median refuge for the long crossing distance.

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large semi-truck is positioned within the intersection, significantly blocking the view between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Long Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk across the main roadway

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
